- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Nez Perce were forced to abandon traditional practices and adapt to a new way of life in reservation camps.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Displacement led to the loss of cultural knowledge and traditions, as younger generations could no longer learn from their elders.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The conflict resulted in the loss of the tribe's sacred lands, integral to their cultural and spiritual beliefs.
